audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows contradict their own whys[]. Level 1 is marked Skill while its why and early[] both say 'Level 1 is hers'; Levels 2, 3 and first item are given to Riven while their whys say Maokai's targeted root ignores her sidesteps and that he is durable enough to eat her full combo; Levels 4-5 is marked Skill while its why calls it 'your peak'.
audit.why: Riven has no answer to a lock-on root: Broken Wings, Ki Burst and Valor are all short-range and her defensive identity is sidestepping skillshots, which does nothing against Twisted Advance. Level 1 she wins on Runic Blade auto-weaving against one Maokai ability, and once she has Black Cleaver and Death's Dance the duel returns to her.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped in both layers to Riven / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai; row 4 already correct at Skill; row 6 deliberately left as Riven (see notes).

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly sequenced: Lvl 1 (hers), Lvl 2-3 (the targeted-root takeover), Lvl 6 (even, gank window), 2+ items (hers on Black Cleaver / Death's Dance).

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: only Ki Burst is ever named — Runic Blade, Broken Wings, Valor and Blade of the Exile appear nowhere. dontsFull[0] and dontsFull[1] both carry filler descriptions unrelated to their titles.
audit.why: The interaction that decides this lane is that Twisted Advance is target-locked, so Riven's entire defensive skill expression is irrelevant to it — that belongs in the full layer and only existed in the content layer. On cooldowns: Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s, Broken Wings a flat 13s for all three casts, and Blade of the Exile 120/90/60s. Naming them turns 'trade around her cooldowns' into an actual instruction.
audit.corrected: phases[0], phases[1], phases[2] name Runic Blade, Broken Wings and the targeted root; dosFull[0].d gives Ki Burst's 11s; dontsFull[1].d gives Blade of the Exile's 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] cites Riven animation-cancelling her Q dashes to weave autos. That is a real technique, but it is not in Riot's text and nothing in the kit file confirms the frame behaviour.
audit.why: Animation cancels are explicitly outside what the kit files can verify, and I have no source I can check for the exact cancel windows. I left the existing line untouched rather than build advice on top of it.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Riven contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Her Broken Wings chip and Runic Blade auto-weaving beat your single Level 1 ability, before W or your combo exists.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Riven's Ki Burst is down.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is a targeted root — it ignores every sidestep she has, and Sap Magic heals the trade back.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Riven must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Your W and Q come back up faster than she can reset the three casts of Broken Wings, so the root-and-poke repeats.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ki Burst's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your peak: constant Sap Magic sustain erases her chip while the root chain keeps landing on a champion who cannot dodge it.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ki Burst's cooldown.
edits.after: Your first Bami item makes you durable enough to eat her full combo and heal through it.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Root/bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Ki Burst is her engage stun, 11s at rank 1. Trade once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Riven's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Ki Burst starts every combo — hold your W root until she has spent the stun.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile is 120s at rank 1 — bait Wind Slash, then commit.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Ki Burst and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. You concede Level 1, own Levels 2-5, and hand the duel back once she finishes two items.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Riven carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, Riven carry threat 8/10.

notes: Row 6 (2+ items) is the one place I did NOT follow the packet: the packet says Skill, but whys[6] and late[] both state plainly that a Black Cleaver / Death's Dance Riven wins the straight 1v1, and both layers already agree on Riven. Leaving it is the consistent choice; flagging it here rather than flipping the page against its own text. Four of five Riven ability names were absent from the whole matchup and are now used where they carry a cooldown or a decision.
